articles.headline: Rio Ferdinand leads reaction to Man City's 115 breaches case: 'Another Premier League medal'
articles.description: The football world has been reacting to reports that Manchester City are expected to be found guilty of most charges in their legal battle with the Premier League.
articles.headlineJa: リオ・ファーディナンド、マンCの115件の違反問題に反応：「プレミアリーグのメダルがもう1枚もらえる」
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・シティがプレミアリーグとの法闘争において大半の容疑で有罪になると見込まれているとの報道に対し、サッカー界で大きな反応が広がっています。
articles.body:
The football world has been reacting to reports that a decision on Manchester City's longstanding legal battle with the Premier League over an alleged 115 breaches of financial regulations may be right around the corner. 

City are expected to be found guilty on the vast majority of charges of financial breaches in their legal case with the Premier League, a source has confirmed to ESPN.

In a statement, City didn't deny the verdicts and said that the process "remains ongoing."

When contacted by ESPN on Friday, the Premier League said they wouldn't comment on a "private and confidential process."

Friday's reports have given fresh impetus to speculation that City could be in line for a hefty punishment, with some hoping the major honours they won during the period covered by the investigation (2009-2018) could be redistributed to their beaten foes. 

- Man City vs. Premier League: 115 financial charges explained

David de Gea, who was part of the Manchester United team that finished as runners-up when City racked up 100 points in 2017-18, wrote in a post on X: "So... Let's talk. How many Premier League titles have I won then?"

His former United teammate Rio Ferdinand posted: "Another premier league medal to be added to the cabinet."

Rodri, who left City for Barcelona this summer, said he believes "everything was deserved." Rodri joined City from Atletico Madrid in 2019, one year after the end of the period in which the charges relate.

"When you live daily at that club, all the people that worked hard all these years to have the success we had, Pep, the owners, all the guys who worked on it, they can't take that from us. It's something that isn't paid for with money, it's effort, partnership, standing shoulder to shoulder," he told a news conference ahead of Spain's Nations League match against England.

"We had a lot of success, here at Wembley, and I can tell you that everything was deserved."

Erling Haaland was due to speak to the media on Saturday ahead of Norway's Nations League match against Portugal on Sunday but head coach Stale Solbakken confirmed that, given the news surrounding City and what happened at Rodri's Spain news conference, it would be better for Haaland to avoid fielding questions on the issue. Fredrik Aursnes and Andreas Schjelderup attended instead.

Oasis frontman and City superfan Noel Gallagher, reacted to the news on the Let Me Talk podcast, saying he was "a little surprised when I heard it on the radio. Surprised because only that the club have assured us all along that they vehemently denied any of these charges.

"So it was a bit of a shock to find out that we've been found guilty of all but one. But really overall just quite sad really. Sad for the fans and for the players."

Asked if it changes the context of moments like Sergio Agüero's title-winning goal in 2012, Gallagher added: "Our focus as fans is always on the pitch and we know what we saw -- they won it on the pitch.

articles.headline: Sources: Cowboys, Lions make trade inquiries on Joey Porter Jr.
articles.description: A handful of teams, including the Cowboys and Lions, have begun making inquiries about the availability of Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., sources told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：カウボーイズとライオンズがジョーイ・ポーター・ジュニアのトレードについて問い合わせ
articles.descriptionJa: 情報筋がESPNに語ったところによると、カウボーイズやライオンズを含むいくつかのチームが、スティーラーズのコーナーバックであるジョーイ・ポーター・ジュニアの獲得可能性について問い合わせを始めている。
articles.body:
A handful of teams, including the Dallas Cowboys and Detroit Lions, have begun making inquiries about the availability of Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr., league sources told ESPN.

The Steelers would be willing to listen to trade offers for Porter, according to sources, but they also would want a strong compensation package if they were to deal the fourth-year star.

Porter has been seeking a new contract, but the Steelers do not negotiate deals during the season, raising questions about the possibility of a trade.

The Cowboys have aggressively overhauled their defense over the last 13 months, acquiring Quinnen Williams, Rashan Gary and Kenny Clark in trades while using first-round draft picks on Caleb Downs and Malachi Lawrence.

But Dallas remains thin at cornerback, where Porter would potentially provide a significant boost. Cowboys starting cornerback Cobie Durant will not play in Week 3 against the Baltimore Ravens because of a hamstring injury.

Another team that could use help in the secondary is the Lions, who have yielded the second-most passing yards in the NFL over the first two weeks of the season. Detroit is without injured safeties Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph, who are both on the PUP list, and cornerback Avonte Maddox, who is out for the season with a foot injury.

Porter has not played yet this season as he continues a prolonged "ramp up" process to return from a back injury. He is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals after being limited in practice this past week.

Porter said Thursday that he "definitely" would play for the Steelers in 2026 despite not getting a contract extension, but was noncommittal about his status against the rival Bengals.

articles.headline: JJ Gabriel and the 'nightmare' battle for Premier League academy talent
articles.description: In the fiercely competitive race for the best Premier League academy players, JJ Gabriel won't be the last young talent at the center of a transfer tug-of-war.
articles.headlineJa: JJ・ガブリエルと、プレミアリーグのアカデミー人材を巡る「悪夢」の争奪戦
articles.descriptionJa: プレミアリーグ最高のアカデミー選手を巡る激烈な争いにおいて、移籍を巡る引き抜き合戦の中心となる若手才能は、JJ・ガブリエルが最後ではないだろう。
articles.body:
The battle for talent is intense in the Premier League.

Manchester City and Manchester United went head-to-head for Elliot Anderson in the summer. Chelsea and Arsenal fought it out for Morgan Rogers.

But the race to sign the world's best players is only part of it. There's also a scramble for players tipped to become stars of the future.

Manchester United are still dealing with the fallout of 15-year-old JJ Gabriel's decision to leave Old Trafford. The forward is yet to make a competitive first-team appearance, but losing a young player considered to be one of the best in Europe for his age is still a significant blow.

The fear for United is that a highly rated prospect who has been in their academy system since the age of 11 goes on to fulfill his potential elsewhere. Barcelona, Real Madrid, Paris Saint-Germain and a host of Premier League clubs have already registered interest in securing Gabriel's signature.

United are proud of their record of having at least one academy graduate in every matchday squad since October 1937. The inclusion of Kobbie Mainoo, Marcus Rashford and Shea Lacey at Fulham on Sunday took the run of matches to 4,368.

Producing players is important for every club and can save millions in transfer fees. But it means there's pressure to identify, sign and retain the right ones, which is much harder than you'd think even for clubs of Man United's caliber.

How does youth development work?

Under the Elite Player Performance Plan, introduced in 2012, youth development in England is split into three phases: foundation phase (U9 to U11), youth development phase (U12 to U16) and professional development phase (U17 to U23).

Academies are separated into four categories. The biggest clubs -- such as Arsenal, Chelsea, Manchester United, Manchester City and Liverpool -- oversee Category 1 academies, which can cost more than £2 million per year to run.

Premier League heavyweights can coach players from any age, although they're not allowed to play official matches until U7s. Before reaching U9s, players can train anywhere and often attend sessions at different academies to find the best fit. They can be formally registered with a club for the first time at the U9 level.

Players can sign a full-time scholarship -- which includes training and education -- as U16s, at which point they're officially allowed to be paid. Before then, financial inducements can include things such as travel expenses, and this element can sometimes lead to a bending of the rules. There are stories of some clubs paying for chauffeured limousines to get players to training or offering executive tickets for matches.

A professional contract can be offered to a U16 player, but can't be signed until a player's 17th birthday. Young players can't employ an agent until they're 16 and can't make a senior appearance in the Premier League until the season they turn 16.

articles.headline: Sources: Raiders TE Brock Bowers expected to play vs. Saints
articles.description: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is expected to play Sunday against the Saints, barring a surprise, a source told ESPN
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：レイダースのTEブロック・バウアーズ、セインツ戦に出場見込み
articles.descriptionJa: 情報筋がESPNに語ったところによると、レイダースのタイトエンドであるブロック・バウアーズは、予期せぬ事態がない限り、日曜日のセインツ戦に出場する見込みだ。
articles.body:
Las Vegas Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is expected to play Sunday against the New Orleans Saints, barring a surprise, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

Coach Klint Kubiak said this week that he was optimistic about Bowers' return, and the Raiders did not elevate a tight end for game day like in previous weeks.

Bowers, who is listed as questionable with a knee injury, missed the first two weeks of the regular season after undergoing a meniscus trim procedure Sept. 8. He practiced on a limited basis Wednesday and Thursday this week before missing Friday's practice, which Kubiak said was planned.

He has missed multiple games due to a knee injury for the second straight year. He suffered a posterior cruciate ligament injury and bone bruise in his left knee in the 2025 season opener against the New England Patriots, played three games with the injury and had to sit out for three games to return to full strength.

With Bowers out to start this season, Michael Mayer has been the top Raiders' top tight end for the first two weeks, catching nine passes for 55 yards.

Bowers, considered one of the best tight ends in the NFL, has caught 176 passes for 1,874 yards and 12 touchdowns over his first two seasons.

articles.headline: How to bet Rams-Broncos on 'SNF': Analysis, tips and favorite plays
articles.description: Odds, bets and analysis to help you bet Rams-Broncos on "Sunday Night Football."
articles.headlineJa: 『SNF』ラムズ対ブロンコス戦のベッティングガイド：分析、ヒント、注目の買い目
articles.descriptionJa: 「サンデーナイトフットボール」のラムズ対ブロンコス戦に賭ける際に役立つオッズ、予想、分析。
articles.body:
Both teams rebounded from a tough Week 1 to look more like themselves last week.

Matthew Stafford threw four touchdowns and recorded a 76 QBR as the Los Angeles Rams beat the New York Giants last week -- even without Puka Nacua and Myles Garrett. And Aaron Donald made his presence felt on defense, with a 30% pass rush win rate at defensive tackle that ranked sixth best at the position in Week 2. Even when not at full strength, this Rams team is mighty dangerous.

And Denver showed that its disjointed Week 1 loss to Kansas City might have been a fluke by beating Jacksonville 20-13. The critical matchup here, of course, is the Rams offense against the vaunted Broncos defense.

Will Pat Surtain II and Riley Moss fare better against Davante Adams than the Giants secondary did (my take: almost unequivocally, yes). And is the Rams running game where it has the advantage in this contest, against a Broncos unit that ranks last (!) in EPA allowed per opponent designed run?

Betting outlook

My first guess was that, at 2.5-point favorites, the market was essentially writing off the Rams' Week 1 loss as a jet lag-inspired fluke. But then I checked ESPN's Football Power Index, and it's even more bullish on Los Angeles in this contest, favoring the Rams by 3.9 points.

Part of that is because the Broncos, despite coming oh-so-close to the Super Bowl last year, didn't get that much respect from the model in the preseason (which means the betting market didn't give that much respect to Denver, either, since FPI's preseason ratings are largely driven by the betting market).

Plus, while both of these teams suffered a blowout loss in Week 1, they are not equal: FPI believes the Rams lost to the best team in football (in San Francisco) while the Broncos were beaten by the fifth-best team in the Chiefs, who the model considers almost a field goal worse than the 49ers.

I'm not betting the spread here, but if I were I would lean Los Angeles.

Notable player props, bets

Note: Odds by DraftKings  and subject to change.

Bo Nix rushing yards UNDER 17.5 (-111)

Ben Solak: Only one scramble through two games for Nix in 2026, which is notable, as Nix was scrambling 2.3 times per game in 2025. It doesn't seem to be related to the ankle injury -- he's moving just fine -- so my theory is that it's related to the new Davis Webb offensive approach. Either the Broncos brass has stressed upon him the importance of putting the ball in play, or Nix is more comfortable with the playcalls as they're given to him and is less likely to cut bait to tuck and go.

Whatever it is, I'll take his under on his rushing yards against the Rams. With the litany of RB injuries the Broncos have, I think the Rams will be willing to play Nix's keeps on read-option a little more aggressively. I also expect the Rams to be a heavy zone team in this game despite the shift to man coverage in Week 2. Nix has historically been a much shakier passer against zone than man coverage. articles.headline: Sources: Myles Garrett faces 6-week timeline from knee surgery
articles.description: Myles Garrett was given a six-week recovery timeline from his knee surgery, meaning the star pass rusher might not return until early November, sources told NFL Network.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：マイルズ・ギャレット、膝の手術で全治6週間の見通し
articles.descriptionJa: マイルズ・ギャレットは膝の手術から6週間の回復期間が見込まれており、スターパスラッシャーの復帰は11月初旬になる可能性があると関係者がNFLネットワークに語った。
articles.body:
Los Angeles Rams star Myles Garrett figures to be on the sideline a little longer than anticipated.

Garrett, the subject of one of the NFL's biggest blockbuster trades in recent memory, was given a timeline of roughly six weeks for his recovery from knee surgery, sources told NFL Network.

The Rams placed Garrett on injured reserve earlier this month after the two-time Defensive Player of the Year hobbled through Los Angeles' season-opening loss to the San Francisco 49ers in Australia.

Garrett is eligible to return from IR after four games, which would be the Rams' Week 6 game on Oct. 18 against the Arizona Cardinals.

But with a six-week timeline, Garrett also could miss games against in Week 7 against the Las Vegas Raiders and in Week 8 against the Los Angeles Chargers. The Rams play the Washington Commanders in Week 9 on Nov. 8.

Garrett is determined to beat the timeline, sources told NFL Network, but the Rams will be cautious with a player they traded significant capital to acquire. The hope was the arthroscopic surgery to clean out his knee relieves discomfort and eliminates swelling.

Coach Sean McVay has been reluctant to put a timeline on Garrett's recovery, calling him "Wolverine, healing fast," while also emphasizing that the Rams are "not going to rush him back."

Garrett missed most of training camp with what McVay called knee swelling. After the Week 1 game in Melbourne, Australia, Garrett declined to say which knee he injured, but he wore a sleeve on his left leg during several practices.

The Rams sent two-time Pro Bowl pass rusher Jared Verse and three draft picks, including a first-round selection in 2027, to the Cleveland Browns in the trade to land Garrett earlier this year. The five-time All-Pro set the NFL's single-season sack record with 23 last season for the Browns.

articles.headline: Liverpool's Alexander Isak leaves Sweden camp early with 'minor injury'
articles.description: Alexander Isak is returning to Liverpool after sustaining a "minor injury" on international duty.
articles.headlineJa: リヴァプールのアレクサンダー・イサク、「軽傷」によりスウェーデン代表キャンプから早期離脱
articles.descriptionJa: アレクサンダー・イサクは代表活動中に「軽傷」を負ったため、リヴァプールへと戻ることになった。
articles.body:
Alexander Isak is returning to Liverpool after sustaining a "minor injury" on international duty.

The striker scored and played the full 90 minutes in Sweden's 2-1 victory over Romania in the Nations League on Friday.

But Isak, who has made a strong start to the season for Liverpool, will not feature in matches against Poland, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Romania over the remainder of the extended international break.

A statement on Liverpool's website read: "Alexander Isak is to return to Liverpool from international duty due to a minor injury.

"The striker will not be involved in Sweden's three remaining fixtures in the current international break and will now be assessed by club medical staff at the AXA Training Centre."

Isak had an injury-disrupted first season at Anfield and Liverpool will hope he is fit for their next Premier League game against Manchester City on Oct. 11.

articles.body:
A group of Premier League clubs are keeping an eye on Trent Alexander-Arnold. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Liverpool, Arsenal, Manchester City, and Chelsea are keeping tabs on Real Madrid right back Trent Alexander-Arnold, reports TEAMtalk. The Premier League clubs have been in contact with the 27-year-old's representatives, who have explored what options could be available should he leave the Bernabéu. Alexander-Arnold is keen to stay put with the LaLiga side this season which has made a potential move in January unlikely, though the situation is expected to be assessed at the end of the season.

- Juventus are interested in Manchester City midfielder Mateo Kovacic, according to Gazzetta dello Sport. The Bianconeri are monitoring the 32-year-old's situation at the Etihad Stadium, where he is set to enter the final six months of his contract in January, and the Serie A club are ready to make an approach to sign him on a free transfer. Kovacic has played just two minutes of football in the Premier League this season across two substitute appearances.

- Bayern Munich are keen on Benfica defender Tomás Araújo, reports Bild journalist Christian Falk. The 24-year-old is said to have been on the Bundesliga side's radar for some time, but whether they push forward for a move for him depends on if they decide to part ways with center back Kim Min-jae. Araujo has been in impressive form so far this season, producing a standout display in the recent 2-0 Europa League win over AC Milan at the San Siro.

- Real Madrid are no longer looking to part ways with defender Raúl Asencio, reports Marca. The 23-year-old dismissed interest from Chelsea and Liverpool in the summer despite Madrid manager Jose Mourinho "showing him the door," and while he hasn't made an appearance in La Liga this season, the situation is now set to change after the injury to Ibrahima Konaté and recent red card to Dean Huijsen during the 2-1 league defeat to Atletico Madrid.

- Roma will demand an offer worth around €100 million should suitors return for midfielder Manu Koné, reports Gazzetta dello Sport. Two goals in the 2-2 draw with Inter Milan continued a promising start to the season for the 25-year-old, who Chelsea made a proposal worth around €60m for in the summer. The Giallorossi now want any potential offer to reflect his recent form and be comparable to Sandro Tonali's £100m switch from Newcastle to Tottenham Hotspur.

articles.headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
articles.description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season
articles.headlineJa: 代表ウィークで負傷したプレミアリーグの選手は誰？
articles.descriptionJa: 2026-2027シーズンの最初の代表ウィーク中に負傷したプレミアリーグのスター選手に関する最新ニュースと更新情報をお届けします。
articles.body:
Premier League teams will be watching and hoping their star players remain healthy throughout the international break.

However, some have already sustained injuries while playing for their countries. Premier League matches resume on Oct. 10.

ESPN will be tracking the latest injuries and updates for your club's players:

Kai Havertz (Arsenal)

Arsenal's Kai Havertz was forced off in the 30th minute of the game between Netherlands and Germany on September 24th with what was described as a muscle injury.

"Both are currently undergoing an MRI," Jurgen Klopp said on RTL about Havertz and Jamal Musiala. "I hope we get the diagnosis [on Thursday] evening. But of course, this isn't great. I hope it's nothing serious. The lads are probably out for us. But hopefully, they'll be back in action relatively quickly."

On September 25 the German Football Association confirmed the attacker would be leaving Klopp's camp and return to Arsenal after suffering what they describe as a 'muscle strain.'

Brian Brobbey (Sunderland)

The powerful Sunderland attacker was also injured in the same game after picking up what looked like a hamstring injury while running for the ball. He immediately went down and signalled to the sideline.

He left the field of his own accord but did have a heavy limp as he walked down the tunnel.

Netherlands boss Xavi Hernandez said after the game: "Brian is indeed injured."

Brobbey was replaced by Joshua Zirkzee in the Dutch squad.

Zion Suzuki (Aston Villa)

The goalkeeper linked up with the Japan squad but according to reports missed the main group training session on September 22nd, according to local reports. Instead he was put on an individual session for a rib injury.

Suzuki was subsequently left out of Japan's matchday squad entirely for Thursday's 3-1 victory over Uruguay.

Dan Ballard (Sunderland)

The Sunderland defender suffered a reported hamstring injury during Northern Ireland's 1-0 victory over Georgia in the UEFA Nations League.

With the score still 0-0 as the match moved into stoppage time, Ballard chased back as Georgia counter-attacked and pulled up clutching the back of his thigh, unable to finish the match in Tbilisi.

Speaking immediately after Friday's match, manager Michael O'Neill said it was too soon to know the extent of his latest injury but will definitely miss the next three Northern Ireland games.

"We'll scan him tomorrow (Saturday), but he's certainly not going to be available for the next three games."

2. Nov. 9-Nov. 17 (between Premier League gameweeks 10 and 11)

3. March 22-March 30 (between Premier League gameweeks 30 and 31)

articles.headline: Host Jalen Brunson gets assist from Knicks on 'SNL' premiere
articles.description: Jalen Brunson had four of his Knicks teammates -- Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Josh Hart -- in the audience for his monologue Saturday night, in his role as host of "SNL."
articles.headlineJa: 『SNL』初回放送でホストを務めたジェイレン・ブランソン、ニックスのチームメイトからアシストを受ける
articles.descriptionJa: 土曜夜の『SNL』でホストを務めたジェイレン・ブランソンは、冒頭モノローグの際、観客席にニックスのチームメイト4人（カール＝アンソニー・タウンズ、ミカル・ブリッジズ、OG・アヌノビー、ジョシュ・ハート）を迎えた。
articles.body:
Jalen Brunson brought four of his NBA champion teammates to "Saturday Night Live."

The reigning NBA Finals MVP had four of his New York Knicks teammates -- Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Josh Hart -- in the audience for his monologue Saturday night, in his role as host of the NBC program's 52nd season premiere.

Brunson poked fun at how he's not going to sing, how ESPN's Stephen A. Smith -- a Knicks fan, portrayed during the monologue by longtime "SNL" star Kenan Thompson -- owed him an apology for questioning his abilities and even quipped about how much he's looking forward to getting back to the Knicks' home court at Madison Square Garden.

"The exact spot where Taylor and Travis got married," Brunson said, referring to the summer wedding of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce at the team's arena.

But the best assists came from Towns, Bridges, Anunoby and Hart, who all asked Brunson questions as part of the monologue.

Towns asked if someone could foul out of "SNL." When told it's not possible, Towns said, "So I can be here, like, the whole show? Nice."

Bridges asked Brunson if his arms were long, but lamented that he'll never fly. Anunoby, who got a huge ovation, asked Brunson if he recalled missing a shot late in Game 4 of the NBA Finals against San Antonio -- a series that the Knicks won in five games. The Game 4 shot that Anunoby was referring to was a last-second tip-in -- off a Brunson miss -- that basically ensured the Knicks would win the game.

"That was awesome," Anunoby said.

Hart, who co-hosts a podcast with Brunson, asked his New York teammate about how he left $113 million on the bargaining table when signing with the Knicks. Brunson, in turn, asked why Hart poked Brunson in the backside when the Knicks won the NBA Cup last season.

Brunson then brought his teammates to the stage for one last roar from the crowd.

Brunson became the first active NBA player to host the show since LeBron James -- then of the Cleveland Cavaliers -- in 2007, and the first pro athlete in the role since Kelce, the Kansas City Chiefs' tight end, in 2023.

The other NBA players to host besides Brunson and James: Michael Jordan in 1991, Charles Barkley on four occasions (including one as an active player in 1993) and Bill Russell in 1979. Russell's stint came 10 years after he retired as a player.

Brunson, Jordan, Barkley and James all hosted season premieres of "SNL." And Brunson promised to step up late, just like what he delivered in crunch time of the Knicks' games in the title series against the Spurs in June.

"I'm going to approach this the same way I approach a Knicks Finals game," Brunson said. "The first three quarters of the show are going to be god-awful. The last sketch is going to be amazing."
